entries.name: transaction-header-28-accept#0
entries.description: A transaction output whose size-flagged v0 tree has header 28 (the size bit and bit 5) and body SigmaProp(true). The JVM reads the version and the size and segregation bits and ignores the others; the header byte is kept as stored. Round-trip identity. An impl that refuses the bits, or rewrites the header, diverges.
